1.text: Maze anyereka Yosuwa umutambyi mukuru ahagaze imbere ya marayika w'Uwiteka, na Satani ahagaze iburyo bwe ngo amurege.

2.text: Uwiteka abwira Satani ati “Uwiteka aguhane, yewe Satani. Ni koko Uwiteka watoranyije i Yerusalemu aguhane. Mbese uwo si umushimu ukuwe mu muriro?”

3.text: Kandi Yosuwa yari yambaye imyenda y'ibizinga, ahagaze imbere ya marayika.

4.text: Marayika abwira abari bamuri imbere ati “Nimumwambure iyo myenda y'ibizinga.” Maze abwira Yosuwa ati “Ngukuyeho gukiranirwa kwawe, kandi ndakwambika imyambaro myiza cyane.”

5.text: Ndategeka nti “Nimumwambike igitambaro cyiza mu mutwe.” Nuko bamwambika igitambaro cyiza mu mutwe, bamwambika n'imyenda. Marayika w'Uwiteka yari ahagaze aho.

6.text: Marayika w'Uwiteka ahamiriza Yosuwa cyane ati

7.text: “Uwiteka Nyiringabo aravuze ati ‘Nuko nugendera mu nzira zanjye kandi ukitondera ibyo nagutegetse, nawe uzacira inzu yanjye imanza n'ibikari byanjye uzabirinda, nanjye nzagushyira mu byegera muri aba bahagaze aha.

8.text: Umva yewe Yosuwa umutambyi mukuru, wowe na bagenzi bawe bahora imbere yawe, kuko abo ari abantu b'ikimenyetso. Dore nzazana umugaragu wanjye Shami uzumbūra.

9.text: Dore ibuye nshinze imbere ya Yosuwa, ku ibuye rimwe hari amaso arindwi, nzarikebaho amabara, ni ko Uwiteka Nyiringabo avuga, kandi gukiranirwa kw'icyo gihugu nzagukuraho umunsi umwe.

10.text: Uwo munsi muzahamagarana, umuntu wese ahamagare mugenzi we, muce agashingwe munsi y'umuzabibu no munsi y'umutini.’ ” Ni ko Uwiteka Nyiringabo avuga.
